Title: Stress Incontinence: 3 Habits That Make Leaks Worse

Description:
Ever leaked a little urine when you cough, sneeze, or laugh? A weak pelvic floor and urethral sphincter can't hold back that sudden pressure - and three everyday habits make it worse: carrying extra weight, heavy caffeine intake, and skipping pelvic floor exercise. Losing just 8% of body weight can cut weekly leaks nearly in half, and Kegels - a 3-5 second squeeze and release, 10 reps, 3 times a day - usually show results within 1-3 months.
